newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST-Mexico 29-day Cetes seen down at 20.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Mexico 29-day Cetes seen down at 20.0 pct.

text.p: Interest rates on Mexico's bellwether 29-day Cetes, or T-bills, are seen falling 23 basis points to 20.00 percent, but rates are seen rising at longer terms, according to a Reuters' survey of nine Cetes dealers.
Following is a table comparing last week's primary rates versus expectations for this week's auction and the expected change in basis points.
TERM LAST WEEK THIS WEEK'S SURVEY CHANGE
The results will be released by Banco de Mexico at 1830 (2330 GMT).
The auction is being held on Monday this week so that that the auction can be settled ahead of Mexico's Labor Day national holiday on May 1.
